replay_protections.cross_node_binding: Permit is strictly bound to target NodeId; rejected if presented to any other storage node
replay_protections.operation_type_binding: Permit is strictly bound to PermitOperationType (StageShard, CommitManifest, DeleteShard, GarbageCollectShard)
replay_protections.epoch_monotonicity: Permit epoch must be >= node's durably recorded high-water mark
replay_protections.commit_index_monotonicity: Permit commit index must be >= node's recorded commit index
replay_protections.generation_conflict_rejection: Replayed permits with conflicting request IDs at current generation are rejected
